newsitem.title: USA: Ryka postpones merger with KPR.
newsitem.headline: Ryka postpones merger with KPR.

text.p: Ryka Inc said on Tuesday that its planned merger with KPR Sport International Inc has been postponed until mid-1997.
The company said it also will restate its first second and third quarters for the reclassification of certain revenues and expenses.
Third quarter sales were increased to $4.22 million from $4.18 million, leading to an increase in net income to $112,735 from $33,587, Ryka said.
Ryka said it reduced its first quarter sales to $1.7 million from $2.0 million and second quarter sales to $1.2 million from $1.6 million.
Ryka's second quarter loss was restated higher to $529,167 from a loss of $471,357, while the first quarter loss was cut to $230,109 from $263,606.
